specs.Item Type Name: RIBSUN plasma 2.1 Bluetooth Home Theatre 40w Output, USB, Aux, Line input, FM 40 W Bluetooth Home Theatre (Black, 2.1 Channel)

features: Immersive 2.1 Channel Surround Sound: Experience movies, music, and games with rich, dynamic, and room-filling audio, delivering a true home theater feel with 2 satellite speakers and 1 subwoofer.

Deep Bass & Crystal-Clear Sound: Engineered for superior audio performance, enjoy powerful, deep bass from the subwoofer combined with clear, crisp sound from the satellite speakers for a balanced listening experience.

Versatile Connectivity Options: Play your music your way with multiple inputs including Bluetooth for wireless streaming from smartphones (like iPhone) and laptops, USB port, TF (SD) Card slot, AUX input, and built-in FM Radio.

Convenient Control & Customization: Easily manage your playback with a full-function remote control and an intuitive front panel featuring Volume and dedicated Bass control knobs, along with Play/Pause, Next, Prev, and Mode buttons.

Stylish Design with LED Lighting: Enhance your entertainment setup with a modern, sleek design. The main subwoofer unit features vibrant LED lighting and an LED display to show the current mode/track information, adding a dynamic visual element.

Compact & Space-Saving Dimensions: The satellite speakers are compact (approx. 9.5 cm×12.2 cm), and the main unit is reasonably sized (approx. 21 cm×15 cm×27 cm), making this system easy to set up in any living room, bedroom, or office space.

Transform your home into a cinematic audio hub with the Ribsun 2.1 Channel 40W Multimedia Speaker System. Designed for music enthusiasts, movie lovers, and gamers, this powerful home audio setup delivers crystal-clear sound, booming bass, and a truly immersive experience that makes every beat come alive. With its stylish design and advanced connectivity options, the Ribsun speaker system is the perfect upgrade for any living room, bedroom, or entertainment space. Featuring a 2.1 channel configuration, this speaker system ensures surround sound quality that brings you closer to the action, whether you’re watching movies, playing video games, or enjoying your favorite playlist. The 90W high-power output guarantees room-filling sound, while the deep bass tones add intensity to your listening experience. Equipped with a fully functional remote control, you can conveniently adjust volume, change tracks, or switch input modes without leaving your seat.
